verdicts.line: The paths you walked last season have hardened into stone.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: A freshly walked trail renders as compacted earth — the ground remembering you — and becomes paver stone after one generation passes.
verdicts.reason: Captures the per-tile aging mechanic where trails become stone after one generation, using the canonical 'ground remembering you' phrase.

verdicts.line: Where grey wanderers drifted, a settlement now stands.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: a fledgling settlement that formed around a zealot you never met
verdicts.reason: Directly reflects the waking experience where wanderers have settled during sleep, showing the world moved on its own.

verdicts.line: The huddle you met is gone. In its place, walls.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: The huddle you met is gone; what you find instead is the answer to what you did and what the world did without you: a fledgling settlement that formed around a zealot you never met, a walled camp where the cowering one's children dug in
verdicts.reason: Exact scenario from the waking centerpiece — the huddle replaced by walls, showing Fear settlement.

verdicts.line: Dirt trails you pressed with your feet now carry travelers in your color.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: Dirt paths you walked now carry travelers in your color
verdicts.reason: Direct quote from the waking experience, showing roads carry allegiance and tribes follow their color's roads.

verdicts.line: The people you left behind have stopped wandering and built.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: tribes that crossed the threshold of feeling have stopped wandering and built
verdicts.reason: Captures the settling rule where devout tribes stop wandering and settle as what they feel.

verdicts.line: The ground you walked remembers you — your trails are now paved.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: A freshly walked trail renders as compacted earth — the ground remembering you — and becomes paver stone after one generation passes.
verdicts.reason: Uses the canonical 'ground remembers you' phrase and the trail-to-pavement aging mechanic.

verdicts.line: A generation has passed. The nomads have chosen where to root.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: A tribe whose average enters the devout band (|value| ≥ 6) and holds it for a generation stops wandering and settles as what it feels
verdicts.reason: Says 'chosen where to root' when uhta's settling rule is mechanical (devout threshold held for a generation), not volitional choice.
verdicts.correction: A generation has passed. The nomads who crossed the threshold have settled as what they feel.

verdicts.line: What was loose earth beneath your feet is now worked stone.

verdicts.reason: Captures the per-tile road aging from loose earth to worked stone after one generation.
